decision: Take all normally terminated, numerically scored appearances of a Top Five player other than Master6 in these batches, globally excluding Master6 matches and all prior family map/id/seed exposures. No outcome or score threshold; score is read for W/D/L description only. When two eligible top-five actors are present, prefer lower pre-frozen ranking number, independent of score. Prespecify exact names absent in 216 training games as the double-held map-and-opponent primary stratum. Other new maps are secondary.
strict_exposure: Exclude all 1475 prior Top Five archives plus old Master6 transfer, prior local native and policy training split identifiers. These 3 newly ingested batches are disjoint from earlier encoders' inspected maps. Broad game-by-game scouting of new batches may occur independently; this is a model-family held panel, never a sealed official exam. Only state before action and logged earlier own command prefix drive the comparisons. No formal map.
fallback: Keep actual number and seat/actor imbalance. Never backfill a missing newer archive with a pre-1475 recording.
